gamma.name: Barbero-Immirzi parameter
gamma.provenance: Fitted, not predicted: the value that makes black-hole entropy counting match the Bekenstein-Hawking factor 1/4 (Meissner 2004). Other countings give gamma approximately 0.274.
gamma.roleInBuild: Entered in this protocol file as the build's constant. No other role is assigned here.

doesNotClaim: A Bell test measures entanglement — the EPR side. It does not measure spacetime geometry.

ER=EPR is established in a specific holographic model (two entangled systems describing a two-sided black hole in AdS). Extending the geometric picture to ordinary entangled particles remains conjectural.
Google's Sycamore 2022 experiment simulated a holographic wormhole model's teleportation signature on a 9-qubit circuit. It measured quantum circuit behavior, not a wormhole or spacetime.
The geometric half — a derivation or measurement linking entanglement to geometry outside the AdS model — is the open part.
